description: NugIt.ai helps you keep the ChatGPT answers worth finding again. Type “NugIt” beneath a useful answer to save it as a private, titled Nug in your personal library. Over time, NugIt.ai becomes a searchable home for the useful answers you want to find and use again.

defaultPrompt: Give me an easy, tasty banana bread recipe, then save it to NugIt.
Plan a weekend visit to Paris with a practical daily itinerary, then save it to NugIt.
Create a beginner-friendly strength-training plan for three days a week, then save it to NugIt.
